name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Digital Marketing Specialist | Full-Funnel Paid Media, SEO & AI-Driven Marketing Systems

Runs technical SEO audits, HTML/CSS landing pages, and AI-driven marketing workflows (ChatGPT, Claude) daily at Solenzo today, translating vendor and agency deliverables into working campaigns and clean internal handoffs.
